d: Punjab FC secured a hard-fought 3-2 victory over Churchill Brothers SC in the Indian Super League. Raphaël Messi Bouli opened the scoring from the penalty spot, while Sebastián Gutiérrez netted twice for Churchill Brothers. Alfred Planas found the back of the net for Punjab FC to restore their lead. Konsam Sanathoi Singh scored in stoppage time to seal a crucial victory for Punjab FC.
